column1: # Dependencies for scripts/install.sh and scripts/install.ps1. Both scripts read
# this file, so it is the only list to edit.
# Columns are tab-separated and every field must be non-empty:
#   group   which --with/--without group the row belongs to
#   name    label shown in the output
#   probe   command(s) proving it is installed: "a|b" means either;
#           "@x" calls a custom probe in each script
#   min     minimum version read from `<probe> --version`, or "-"
#           packages to install: a space-separated list, "cask:x" for a
#           Homebrew cask, "@x" for a custom installer in the script,
#           "?" when there is no package (the script warns), "-" when the
#           row does not apply on that platform (skipped silently)
# Keep this file ASCII: Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads it in the ANSI code page.
# winget IDs not yet checked against `winget search`: PHP.PHP.8.4,
# Erlang.ErlangOTP, Swift.Toolchain, Microsoft.DotNet.SDK.10. A wrong ID only
